title: Fix Desktop Tailwind CSS Not Loading
description: The desktop globals.css has @import "tailwindcss" source("../js") which restricts Tailwind scanning to only semio/js. The desktop's own renderer.tsx classes are never generated. Fix by following sketchpad's pattern.
summary: Fixed Tailwind CSS not loading in desktop app. The globals.css had @import "tailwindcss" source("../js") which restricted class scanning to only semio/js, meaning the desktop's own renderer.tsx classes were never generated. Changed to @import "../ui/globals.css" (matching sketchpad's pattern) which chains through the shared UI globals with unrestricted Tailwind scanning. Verified 106KB of CSS is now generated with all required utility classes.
